whenToUse: A one-page checkout: contact, delivery, Turkish or international address, payment and agreement.
Stores that need card checks, instalments, bank transfer or pay at the door, and company invoices.
avoidWhen: Reviewing cart contents before paying — use cart-01.
A long non-commerce form split into steps — use multi-step-form.
a11y: Collapsible summary uses aria-expanded with aria-controls; keep every field labelled with errors in text.
Move focus to the first invalid field on submit.
